subject: science

covers: Know that plants have roots, leaves, stems and flowers.
Explain that plants need water and light to grow.
Know that water is taken in through the roots and moves up the stem.
Know that plants need healthy roots, leaves and stems to grow well.
Know that temperature affects how plants grow.
Know the life processes shared by humans and animals: nutrition, movement, growth and reproduction.
Describe how living things differ from non-living things, using life processes.
Explore exercise and a varied, healthy diet.
Know that some foods, such as very sweet or fatty foods, can harm health.
Explore the human senses and how we use them to learn about the world.
Sort living things into groups using simple features, and explain the grouping.

gaps: Scientific enquiry, Chemistry and Physics have no Stage 3 examples in the public outline.
Earth and space: not verified (see Stage 1 note).
